name: NdaSelfServiceGenerator
tagline: Let the business generate NDAs in minutes – legal only sees the deviations.
description: A complete self-service NDA module for Power Apps and Power Pages: guided four-step NDA generator with template recommendation and live clause preview, automatic approval of standard NDAs, risk-based routing of deviations to legal reviewers or senior counsel, per-deviation fallback decisions, signature tracking, and a searchable repository with expiry alerts and renewals.
features: Live clause-by-clause NDA preview with highlighted deviations
Automatic deviations for term, confidentiality and governing law
Duplicate-NDA warning and 'Do we already have an NDA?' lookup
Bulk assign, reminders, archive and CSV export with undo
8 KPI tiles incl. self-service rate and turnaround
